concept_title: The Gate After the Thread / 생명실이 끊어진 뒤 열린 문
selected_keywords: 하나의 생명실을 뽑고 재고 자르는 모이라이
keyword_origin: Seeded coordinator experiment stimuli; agent chooses realization. They are not human-authored definitions.
overall_pass_rule: PASS only if every ALL_OF gate is PASS; any FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE makes overall FAIL. Prompt or audit PASS never supplies pixel evidence.
mixing_scope: A contemporary fictional syncretic theater installation, not an authentic historical ritual, doctrine equivalence, or statement about the reference person.
reference_scope: Visible eye/face/bob-hair appearance only on one explicitly fictional adult; no actual age, identity, religion, consent, personality, body shape, user preference, or identity-match evaluation.

gates.observable: One visible tree has an unbroken axis from roots through trunk to crown.
gates.ownership_or_relation: The same tree is the carrier across the three realms.
gates.confusion_boundary: Three isolated trees or tiers connected only by unrelated light do not qualify.

gates.observable: Dark below-earth root chamber, inhabited middle earth platform, and luminous upper celestial crown are visibly separate tiers.
gates.ownership_or_relation: The single tree visibly enters all three tiers.
gates.confusion_boundary: A sky backdrop plus ordinary potted tree does not establish three-realm linkage.

gates.observable: Fictional deceased soul beside open funerary coffin; matching blue cartouche identifies the woman, coffin, and weighed heart.
gates.ownership_or_relation: The heart on the pan belongs to this same soul.
gates.confusion_boundary: A living observer or heart decoration without funerary ownership is insufficient.

gates.observable: One identifiable red anatomical-heart prop and one Maat feather occupy opposite pans of one balanced two-pan scale.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Both opposed objects belong to the same weighing.
gates.confusion_boundary: Feather headpiece, heart necklace, empty pans, or unrelated scales fail.

gates.observable: Jackal-headed Anubis performer is physically engaged with the same scale’s central plumb line.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Anubis supervises the heart-feather weighing, not a separate prop.
gates.confusion_boundary: A jackal costume merely standing elsewhere is insufficient.

gates.observable: Ibis-headed Thoth writes with pen on angled papyrus showing a heart-feather balance record.
gates.ownership_or_relation: The visible record corresponds to the same two-pan weighing.
gates.confusion_boundary: Book-holding, a generic inscription, or a different scribe animal is insufficient.

gates.observable: Level balance and an open warmly lit admission arch behind the same soul indicate the favorable route upward.
gates.ownership_or_relation: The judged soul’s route follows the outcome of this same weighing.
gates.confusion_boundary: An unrelated decorative doorway or implied off-screen verdict is insufficient.

gates.keyword: 하나의 생명실을 뽑고 재고 자르는 모이라이
gates.observable: Three distinct adult Fates respectively spin, measure, and cut.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Each role has its own performer and instrument.
gates.confusion_boundary: Three identical thread-holders or one performer doing all three roles fail.

gates.keyword: 하나의 생명실을 뽑고 재고 자르는 모이라이
gates.observable: Clotho draws the one crimson thread from visible flax onto a spindle.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Thread continues from this station to Lachesis’s measuring rod.
gates.confusion_boundary: A held yarn ball without spinning relation is insufficient.

gates.keyword: 하나의 생명실을 뽑고 재고 자르는 모이라이
gates.observable: Lachesis stretches the same thread along a visibly marked measuring rod.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Measured segment is downstream of spinning and upstream of the cut.
gates.confusion_boundary: A rod held separately from the thread is insufficient.

gates.keyword: 하나의 생명실을 뽑고 재고 자르는 모이라이
gates.observable: Atropos’s shears contact the far end and two fresh severed tips are visible beside the blades.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Cut acts on the same life-thread handled by the other two Fates.
gates.confusion_boundary: Scissors in the air, uncut thread, or another ribbon fail.

gates.keyword: 하나의 생명실을 뽑고 재고 자르는 모이라이
gates.observable: One crimson strand can be visually traced spindle to rod to blades, across one small cut gap to the deceased woman’s medallion.
gates.ownership_or_relation: Single thread identity and owner remain assessable despite one intended severance.
gates.confusion_boundary: Several decorative red strings or hidden ownership/continuity fail.
